meta.about: The values every Alternative Dublin tool shares. Tape Type keeps this file; the event guide, Guide Studio and Good Eye copy it with their sync scripts. Change a value here, then sync each tool. Decided by Shaun on 2 October 2026.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: The brand yellow: tape behind headlines on dark covers, every tag (eyebrows, page numbers, time tags), and the logo and swipe arrow wherever it reads. Lettering on it is `dark`. On yellow tape or a yellow ground, a tag turns `light`.

tokens.name: light
tokens.usage: The one white (there is no pure white): light pages, light tape, the inside page's label tape, and titles, highlights and marks on `dark`. Lettering on it is `dark`.

tokens.name: dark
tokens.usage: Ink and dark ground: lettering on `yellow` and `light`, dark pages and covers behind photos.

tokens.name: grey-on-dark
tokens.usage: Story text on `dark` pages (11:1 on `dark`). Titles, highlights and words in stars stay `light`.

tokens.name: grey-on-light
tokens.usage: Story text on `light` pages (8:1 on `light`).

tokens.name: meta
tokens.usage: Dates, venues, handles and footer details. 3.7:1 on `light` and 4.5:1 on `dark`, so only at 24px and up: every use is 31px or more.

families.barlow: "Barlow GX", "Barlow GX Normal", Barlow, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: cover-headline
styles.sample: How to Make the Most of a Weekend Visit to Dublin
styles.usage: Tape Type post and video covers: Bold, as typed (Title Case by default), the largest size from 90px down to 72px that fits, lines 0.94 apart, `dark` on `light` tape.

styles.name: cover-carousel
styles.usage: Guide Studio carousel covers: Bold at 196px, −3% tracking, 85% line height, on rough-cut tape: `light` on Picks, `yellow` on What's New.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The tag seated on a cover's first line: ExtraBold capitals, 34–41px (nine tenths of the published 38–46), on clean-cut `yellow` tape in `dark`.

styles.name: date-strip
styles.usage: Guide Studio's carousel covers: the dates as a tag on the headline's tape. ExtraBold capitals at 48px on clean-cut tape (`yellow` on Picks, `light` on What's New) in `dark`, turned slightly.

styles.name: supporting-line
styles.sample: New openings, good stories and more…
styles.usage: What's New covers only: one to three lines under the tape, Medium, `light`, its last line level with the arrow's foot.

styles.name: story-title
styles.sample: Light House Cinema plans major Smithfield expansion
styles.usage: The story-title style every tool shares: capitals at the variable font's 168 (ExtraBold to the eye). Tape Type's inside pages: the largest size from 52px down to 45px that fits three lines, `light` on `dark`.

styles.name: story-title-carousel
styles.usage: Guide Studio's story pages: 168 in capitals at 64px, zero tracking (69px until 5 October 2026, when the stories grew to the length the team writes).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The Light House Cinema has applied for planning permission to add two new screens.
styles.usage: Story text: Regular, 38px, lines 1.3 apart, one size for everything under the title. `grey-on-dark` on dark pages, `grey-on-light` on light ones; words in stars go Bold in `light`.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: A box set a size up in Tape Type (text or highlight): 42px, lines 1.2 apart.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tags on pages: Tape Type's label (on `light` tape), Guide Studio's page numbers and the event guide's times (on `yellow`). ExtraBold capitals, 38px, `dark`, on tape with the clean cut, the lettering on the margin and the tape overhanging it.

styles.name: guide-title
styles.usage: Event names: 168 in capitals at 47px, `dark` on `light`.

styles.name: guide-meta
styles.usage: The venue and Instagram handle under each event: Condensed at 100, −3% tracking, `meta`.

styles.name: guide-wordmark
styles.usage: Beside the Dublin mark in the footer, in capitals, `dark`.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Every page's footer: Condensed SemiBold, 36px, lines 40px apart, where space is at a premium (Bold at normal width, 31px, until 5 October 2026). Names and handles in ink, dates and details in `meta`, title case (Mon 14 Sep). Two handles stack, one to a line.

tokens.name: safe-cover
tokens.usage: Covers: lettering keeps 80px from every edge; tape and tags may reach into it. The logo and arrow sit on its corners.

tokens.name: margin-inside
tokens.usage: Inside and story pages: text starts 56px from the sides.

tokens.name: picture-height
tokens.usage: The picture at the top of Tape Type's inside pages. Every page has the same height, so the story keeps to the room under it.

tokens.name: picture-height-carousel
tokens.usage: The picture at the top of Guide Studio's story pages, a little shorter than Tape Type's so a full story fits under a two-line title (540px until 5 October 2026).

tokens.name: grid-crop-post
tokens.usage: Instagram's profile grid shows a 3:4 crop of a 4:5 post: about 34px off each side. Nothing that must show in the grid goes there.

tokens.name: grid-crop-video
tokens.usage: The grid also cuts the top and bottom 240px of a 9:16 video cover, so its lettering keeps 80px inside what is left.

tokens.name: guide-padding-sides
tokens.usage: Event guide pages: 75px at the sides and top (Shaun's own margins).

tokens.name: guide-padding-bottom
tokens.usage: Event guide pages: 60px under the footer.

tokens.name: guide-event-gap
tokens.usage: Event guide: the space between events.

tokens.name: guide-footer-guard
tokens.usage: Event guide: the least room kept between the last event and the footer, measured where the event ends.

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: Every post, page and video cover is 1080px wide.

tokens.name: page-height
tokens.usage: Posts and pages are 4:5, 1080 × 1350.

tokens.name: video-height
tokens.usage: Video covers are 9:16, 1080 × 1920.

tokens.name: logo-cover
tokens.usage: The Alternative Dublin logo on covers, top corner of the safe area.

tokens.name: logo-inside
tokens.usage: The logo on an inside page, when it is on (off by default).

tokens.name: arrow
tokens.usage: The painted swipe arrow, bottom right, in the logo's colour.

tokens.name: dublin-mark
tokens.usage: The graffiti Dublin mark in the event guide's footer, `dark`.

tokens.name: regular
tokens.usage: Barlow GX's own weight scale runs 22–188 (stem thickness in thousandths of the size). Regular, CSS 400: story text.

tokens.name: medium
tokens.usage: Medium, CSS 500: What's New's supporting line.

tokens.name: semibold
tokens.usage: SemiBold, CSS 600: words in single stars, footers.

tokens.name: bold
tokens.usage: Bold, CSS 700: cover headlines, words in double stars.

tokens.name: extrabold
tokens.usage: ExtraBold, CSS 800: every tag. Story titles sit just above it, at 168.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Black, CSS 900: the published feature covers measured as Black; the tools no longer use it.

tokens.name: photo-darken
tokens.usage: Tape Type and Good Eye lay 15% `dark` over every cover photo, under the artwork (a switch in Tape Type).

tokens.name: cover-scrim
tokens.usage: Guide Studio's carousel covers start with a 30% scrim over the photos, adjustable.

tokens.name: cut-headline
tokens.usage: Post covers: the headline's tape has the rough cut, its wider strip at the bottom on Guide Studio's covers.

tokens.name: cut-tag
tokens.usage: Every tag (eyebrows, labels, page numbers, time tags): Tape Type's clean cut, each with its own seed, the foot kept flat where a tag sits on tape.

tokens.name: cut-video
tokens.usage: Video covers start with the Tape cut.
